name: Grilled Teriyaki Shrimp & Pineapple Kabobs with Quinoa

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 18-24 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and ginger.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, whisk together garlic, ginger, soy sauce, honey, and vinegar. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup soy sauce
⅓ cup honey
⅓ cup rice vinegar

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.
Add cornstarch slurry to the saucepan in a steady stream while stirring quickly. Cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.

instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pineapples
3 red bell peppers
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Cut the skin off pineapples, core, and cut into 1-inch pieces. Seed and cut bell peppers into 1-inch pieces.
Heat a large grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.

Meanwhile, thread shrimp, pineapple, and bell peppers onto skewers and place them on a plate. Spoon sauce over both sides of skewers. Alternatively, you can cook the shrimp, pineapple, and bell pepper pieces directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
Coat the grill pan or skillet with oil. Cooking in batches if necessary, place kabobs on the grill. Cook 2 minutes, then flip and cook 2 minutes more, until shrimp are cooked through.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle.
To serve, divide quinoa and kabobs between plates. Top with green onions and enjoy!
